 Nations League Group A4 - Norway v Wales (17:00 GMT) in Oslo
 Brennan Johnson wins 50th cap for Wales
 Dan James has Wales' best chance of first half but is denied by Norway goalkeeper Egil Selvik
 Antonio Nusa breaks the deadlock before hour mark to put Norway in front
 Live Reporting
 Ian Mitchelmore
 Most recent Most popular GOAL - Norway 2-0 Wales published at 68 mins 68 mins 
 Andreas Schjelderup 
 He's only been on the pitch for a few minutes, but Andreas Schjelderup doubles Norway's lead.
 Antonio Nusa gently prods the ball into the path of Erling Haaland who picks out Schjelderup who has the simple task of netting at the back post.
 We have a VAR check for a potential offside... but the goal is given.
 30 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 68 mins 68 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 Nathan Blake 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio Wales 
 In a game where you now need a goal, you hope Mark Harris can take his opportunity and get Wales back in the game.
 4 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 67 mins 67 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 Jay Dasilva with a crucial clearing header at the back post.
 Norway are on top here, and Wales briefly find themselves in survival mode.
 8 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 66 mins 66 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 Oscar Bobb and Thelo Aasgaard are both withdrawn.
 Patrick Berg and Andreas Schjelderup are the men who come off the bench for the hosts.
 11 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 65 mins 65 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 Within a minute of coming off the bench, Mark Harris controls the ball nicely before shooting at goal.
 It's a routine save for Selvik, although that's a positive impact early on from Harris.
 14 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 65 mins 65 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 Danny Gabbidon 
Former Wales defender on BBC Radio Wales 
 If Norway, were going to score it was always going to be Nusa. The first real moment of quality we have seen. 
 It will be interesting to see how Wales react now. 
 14 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 64 mins 64 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 That goal has certainly settled the home fans who were growing increasingly anxious prior to Nusa's strike.
 Wales came from behind to win the reverse fixture, mind.
 Mark Harris comes on for Lewis Koumas as Craig Bellamy makes his first change of the match.
 11 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 62 mins 62 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 Nathan Blake 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio Wales 
 A really good finish, a first moment of quality we have seen and it ends up in a goal.
 30 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 61 mins 61 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 Nusa's strike was Norway's first shot on target in the match.
 28 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 60 mins 60 mins 
 Norway 1-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 The Norwegian Neymar causing problems again for Norway.
 The flags are waving from the home crowd. There, for once, is not any bodies in the way and Karl Darlow gets a hand to it. But it is not enough. 
 A real up and coming star in Antonio Nusa and this is just the beginning for him.
 25 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Norway 1-0 Wales published at 59 mins 59 mins 
 Antonio Nusa 
 Image source, Getty Images Julian Ryerson takes the Norway corner this time, although Joe Rodon rises highest to head clear.
 The ball drops to Antonio Nusa who cuts inside on to his right foot on the edge of the box, and he smashes it beyond Karl Darlow who can't quite get his right hand to it.
 1-0 to Norway.
 That's Nusa's 10th goal for his country.
 125 95 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 59 mins 59 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Joe Rodon heads Martin Odegaard's cross to safety.
 Norway are looking to apply some pressure now.
 Neco Williams is alert to the danger on the right flank as he challenges Antonio Nusa. Norway have a corner.
 16 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 58 mins 58 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 A point would force Norway into having to beat Denmark away in the next game. 
 Huge pressure on them if they don't pick up a win here.
 12 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 57 mins 57 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Wales stay patient just outside the Norway 18-yard box, but they can't find a way through as Wilson is robbed of possession.
 Norway then win a free kick inside their own half to get themselves back in possession.
 Again, Wales will be encouraged by how they have started this second half.
 11 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 55 mins 55 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 What a block by Liam Cullen. 
 17 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 54 mins 54 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Wilson's hold-up play is excellent, and he tees up James who charges up the right wing, although his attempted ball into the Norway box is intercepted.
 Once again, the hosts go up the other end, and Ben Davies and Jay Dasilva combine to thwart Oscar Bobb.
 Norway have the corner... Martin Odegaard's in-swinger is punched clear by Darlow.
 Nusa does so well to play a cute pass to Berge whose shot is blocked by Cullen. Absolutely vital intervention.
 12 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 53 mins 53 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nathan Blake 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio Wales 
 Craig Bellamy would have been delighted at half-time. Norway only looked a threat on three or four occasions but so did Wales. 
 The pressure is on Norway to get something out of this game.
 15 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 52 mins 52 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Wilson and James combine on the right, but the latter can't find his Leeds and Wales team-mate in the box.
 Norway counter, but Williams does brilliantly to win the ball off Haaland in his own box.
 14 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 51 mins 51 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Wales push up the pitch to force Norway backwards, and they win a throw-in.
 That fully encapsulated what Bellamy wants from his troops.
 11 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 49 mins 49 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 The disguise on the through ball was good from Dasilva. 
 It was a nice bit of creativity from Wales.
